name: Air Fryer Lamb Seekh Kebabs with Roti and Mint Yogurt

components.name: Lamb Seekh Kebabs

ingredients.name: Raw onion, grated and squeezed dry
Fresh coriander leaves and stems, chopped

steps: Grate onion finely and squeeze out as much liquid as possible. Finely chop ginger, garlic, chilli and fresh coriander.
Mix the onion mixture into minced lamb with cumin, ground coriander, garam masala and salt. Knead several minutes until sticky and cohesive; refrigerate at least 1 hour.
Shape lamb into 12 even sausage-shaped seekh kebabs, approximately two per portion. Wooden skewers are optional; if used, verify that they fit the basket and are air-fryer safe.
Preheat air fryer to 200 C. Arrange kebabs with air space between; oil lightly and air fry about 10-14 minutes per batch, turning halfway, until ground lamb reaches 71 C in the centre.

components.name: Wholewheat Roti

ingredients.name: Six large ready-made wholewheat roti or flatbreads

steps: Portion two cooked kebabs and one roti per serving. Keep chilled yogurt and tomato-cucumber salad in separate containers; freeze only kebabs and bread if needed.

components.name: Mint Yogurt & Salad
steps: Combine Greek yogurt with finely chopped mint and lemon. Dice tomato and cucumber for fresh salad. Warm roti only when ready to eat.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Original Kenny McGovern seekh kebab uses 500 g lamb. UNHANGRY doubles lamb and adds a measured roti, salad and mint-yogurt meal for six portions.
Planning: Refrigeration minimum 1 hour before cooking; air fryer needs at least two batches. Ground lamb cooked to 71 C.
Freezer: kebabs freeze very well, roti freezes; fresh salad and yogurt better made separately
Dietary: Wheat in roti; milk in yogurt. No pork.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
